name: dingen
description: Connects Claude to your self-hosted Dingen task manager (MCP) and teaches it the Things workflow: capture to the Inbox, plan with when-dates, keep deadlines for real deadlines.

dingen_url.title: Dingen URL
dingen_url.description: Base URL of your Dingen server, without a trailing slash, for example https://dingen.example.com

dingen_token.title: API token
dingen_token.description: An API token from the Account page in Dingen (starts with dgn_)
